Evaluate an LLM on the medical device classification benchmark

evaluateDeviceClassifier.Rd

Uses the vitals package to evaluate an ellmer Chat model's accuracy with classifyMedicalDevices() against a labelled benchmark dataset.

Runs classifyMedicalDevices() once and produces a separate vitals Task and accuracy score ("C" = Correct, "I" = Incorrect) for each of the five classification columns:

  • is_medical_device: Scored across all rows in data.

  • device_class, medical_speciality, is_implantable, is_active: Scored across true medical devices (expected_is_device == "yes").

Usage

evaluateDeviceClassifier(
  chat,
  data,
  batchSize = 1L,
  maxRetries = 3L,
  name = "medical_device_classification",
  view = FALSE
)

Arguments

chat

An ellmer Chat object to evaluate.

data

A labelled benchmark data.frame or tibble containing device_name, expected_is_device, expected_class, expected_speciality, expected_is_implantable, and expected_is_active.

batchSize

Integer scalar passed to classifyMedicalDevices().

maxRetries

Integer scalar passed to classifyMedicalDevices().

name

Character scalar prefix for the vitals Task names (e.g., "gemini-2.5-flash"). Defaults to "medical_device_classification".

view

Logical scalar. Whether to open the vitals Inspect log viewer for the is_medical_device task after evaluation. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A list (invisibly) with three elements:

  • summary: A tibble with column, n_evaluated, n_correct, and accuracy (percentage) for each of the five columns.

  • tasks: A named list of five evaluated vitals Task objects (is_medical_device, device_class, medical_speciality, is_implantable, is_active). Use vitals::vitals_bind() to combine them or res$tasks$device_class$view() to inspect a specific column.

  • results: A tibble combining data with the model's predictions.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(ellmer)
library(vitals)

chat <- chat_google_gemini(model = "gemini-2.5-flash")
eval_res <- evaluate_device_classifier(chat, name = "gemini-2.5-flash")

# Per-column accuracy table
eval_res$summary

# Combine all 5 vitals tasks into one tibble
do.call(vitals_bind, eval_res$tasks)

# Inspect errors for a specific column
eval_res$tasks$device_class$get_samples()
} # }
